description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger An attack from your marked target would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

The custom expects you to carry the blade home. You have never once been the one who needed carrying.

You are reduced to 1 Hit Point instead, and your marked target takes damage equal to what it just dealt you, with no save. The duel does not end because one of you nearly did.

cinderfall.incomplete: On an attack from the marked target that would reduce the caster to 0 HP: the caster drops to 1 HP instead, and the mark takes damage equal to what it just dealt, with no save. No rule element prevents or floors the caster's own HP loss below a set value (same gap as one-more-fight), and reflecting damage onto a different creature has no selector reaching a different creature's own value -- compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
